comparison.title: Brass vs. Alloy Nipples: How to Choose
comparison.intro: When configuring a wheelset, the choice between brass and alloy affects weight, durability, and aesthetics. Here is a breakdown to help you decide.

weight.title: Weight
weight.impact: Impact: Significant rotational weight savings across 44-72 nipples positioned at the rim perimeter.

color.title: Color Options
color.brassBody: Limited (Black/Silver). Black coating may fade over time.
color.alloyBody: Anodized in vibrant colors (Red, Blue, Gold, Purple, etc.).

strength.title: Strength & Engagement
strength.extendedBody: Double Square/Hex heads allow full thread engagement, offering higher shear strength than standard 12mm nipples, which often only engage two-thirds.

assembly.title: Assembly
items: Alloy has less threading friction (less wind-up).
Alloy requires precise tools (4-sided/Squorx) to prevent rounding.
High-end Alloy (Sapim Polyax) uses 7075-T6 heat treatment.

corrosion.title: Corrosion Resistance
corrosion.brassBody: Naturally robust against corrosion. Best for coastal/winter riding.
corrosion.alloyBody: Cheap alloy corrodes easily. Premium alloy (Sapim) has special treatments outperforming basic plated brass.

depth.title: Rim Depth & Spoke Entry Angles
depth.body: As rims get deeper (≥40-50mm), the angle at which spokes enter the rim becomes sharper. Standard nipples may bind against the rim bed, causing spoke bending. Using Polyax (rounded head) nipples and appropriate internal/extended designs helps align the spoke line.
depth.challengeBody: On deep rims, nipples have less room to tilt. If the nipple cannot align with the spoke hub flange, the spoke bends at the threaded section, leading to fatigue failures.
depth.matchedBody: We recommend rims with matched drilling (angled holes) or using Polyax nipples plus washers to strictly minimize spoke bending.

doubleSquare.title: Double Square
doubleSquare.body: Extended head with a square tool interface. Allows tightening from inside the rim.

internal.title: Internal (Upside Down)
internal.body: Hidden inside the rim. Clean aero look.
items: Avoid on >50mm deep rims (tool access issues)

secureLock.title: Secure Lock
secureLock.body: Mechanical locking mechanism stamped into the nipple. Prevents loosening without messy glue.

washers.title: Why Washers Matter
washers.body: Washers increase the contact area between the nipple and rim bed. They act like a micro spherical seat, allowing the nipple to better align with the spoke angle, reducing bending stress and preventing rim bed damage.
